Name: ave_ele_diele
Definition: spherically averaged electronic (ion-clamped) dielectric constant of the pristine host, from DFPT

Name: ave_ion_diele
Definition: spherically averaged ionic dielectric constant of the pristine host, from DFPT

Name: band_gap
Definition: band gap of the pristine host from the PBEsol(+U) calculation, not the hybrid gap

Name: cbm_s, cbm_p, cbm_d, cbm_f
Definition: fraction of s, p, d or f orbital character in the conduction-band minimum of the pristine host (projection ratio)

Name: vbm_s, vbm_p, vbm_d, vbm_f
Definition: fraction of s, p, d or f orbital character in the valence-band maximum of the pristine host (projection ratio)

Name: formation_energy
Definition: formation energy of the host oxide per atom from the Materials Project database (empirically corrected)

Name: ave_bec
Definition: spherically averaged Born effective charge (one third of the trace) of the oxygen to be removed (DFPT)

Name: bader_charge
Definition: Bader charge of the oxygen to be removed, from the all-electron density of the pristine unit cell; negative for the anion

Name: bader_volume
Definition: Bader (zero-flux) volume of the oxygen to be removed

Name: nn_ave_ave_bec, nn_max_ave_bec, nn_min_ave_bec
Definition: solid-angle-weighted mean, maximum and minimum of the averaged Born effective charge over the Voronoi neighbours of the oxygen site

Name: nn_ave_bader_charge, nn_max_bader_charge, nn_min_bader_charge
Definition: solid-angle-weighted mean, maximum and minimum of the Bader charge over the Voronoi neighbours of the oxygen site

Name: o2p_center_from_vbm
Definition: centroid of the oxygen p projected density of states of the oxygen site, as its distance below the valence-band maximum [Deml2015intrinsic]

Name: nn_ave_eleneg, nn_max_eleneg, nn_min_eleneg
Definition: solid-angle-weighted mean, maximum and minimum of the Pauling electronegativity over the Voronoi neighbours (cations and oxygen)

Name: w_X
Definition: fraction of the solid angle of the Voronoi cell of the oxygen site (pristine unit cell) that faces element X, for each element of the dataset
